implementation.analysis: Report per-symbol distributions and asset-class/schedule heterogeneity first; panel aggregates remain descriptive. Do not use this wave as an independent outer evaluation for the already frozen six-symbol panel.
implementation.capture: Read-only Pepperstone cTrader/Open API capture bound to the accepted account fingerprint; exact symbol IDs and names; M5 alignment; no forward fill, synthetic bars, or resampling; duplicate and conflicting-timestamp validation; deterministic hash-bound package.
implementation.sufficiency: Require at least six active weeks, schedule-adjusted coverage of at least 0.97, zero unresolved chronology conflicts, and complete provenance before any structural result is interpreted.

selection_semantics.economic_boundary: No notional PnL, shared-account realization, candidate economics, V2 identity, protected forward, competition start, or live orders.
selection_semantics.promotion_rule: Only a later separately frozen candidate methodology with broker-realistic cost authority and independent outer data may support economic interpretation.
selection_semantics.screening_procedure: After capture, apply a prospectively frozen, mechanism-agnostic structural audit covering chronology, schedule-adjusted coverage, gap/event density, volatility and opportunity proxies, response persistence, cross-symbol dependence, and conservative friction-readiness diagnostics. Do not select or discard a mechanism family from the observed result.
selection_semantics.selection_basis: Broker-native feasibility, asset-class and schedule diversity, expected information gain, and disjointness from the accepted C031 twelve-symbol wave and fixed six-symbol outer panel.

next_research_state.required_gate: Exact-head-green implementation binding and deterministic capture acceptance before structural screening.
next_research_state.research_scope: Broader broker-native universe remains open; this wave is development-only and cannot close any mechanism family.

objective.goal: Measure whether structurally diverse, previously untested Pepperstone-feasible instruments provide transferable opportunity density and mechanism-relevant response heterogeneity beyond the observed six-symbol session-gap panel, without opening economic outcomes.
objective.information_gain_rationale: The confirmed MXNJPY structural result is friction-failed and the remaining fixed-panel members do not support promotion; the broader feasible universe remains open. A small stratified broker-native wave across distinct asset classes and schedules can test whether the observed behavior is localized or portable while preserving disjoint scope, multiple-testing discipline, and the no-family-closure rule.
